summary: fix(settings): send the pairing resume token as a subprotocol
description:
Because:

- The channel server now reads the resume token from the WebSocket subprotocol instead of the URL, and rotates it on each resume.

This commit:

- Sends the token as the `resume.<token>` subprotocol when the pairing socket reconnects.
- Adds a test that a later drop resumes with the rotated token.

Refs: FXA-14663
